news.title: Denmark's leaders are cautiously optimistic about Trump's announcement of a Greenland deal
news.summary: U.S., Greenlandic and Danish officials had quietly negotiated for months behind the scenes, searching for solutions to address some of Trump's security concerns about the territory.
